description: This file declares the VsockCameraDevice class, which implements the ICameraDevice interface for a virtual socket-based camera device in the Android hardware camera framework. It includes method declarations for camera resource management, characteristics retrieval, torch mode control, device opening, and state dumping, along with private members for device configuration and connection handling.

classes.name: VsockCameraDevice
classes.description: A class implementing the ICameraDevice interface for a virtual socket-based camera device, managing camera settings, connection, and session lifecycle.

methods.name: VsockCameraDevice
methods.description: Constructor initializing the camera device with an ID, settings, and connection.

methods.name: getResourceCost
methods.description: Retrieves the resource cost associated with the camera device.

methods.name: open
methods.description: Opens the camera device and initializes the session.

methods.name: dumpState
methods.description: Dumps the current state of the camera device for debugging.
